hospital.name: Sutter Delta Medical Center
hospital.snippet: Sutter Delta Medical Center Emergency Department is located at 3901 Lone Tree Way, Antioch CA 94509 and is part of the Sutter Health Network.

police.name: Antioch Police Department
police.snippet: The department is located downtown at 300 "L" Street, near the Marina.

court.court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Contra Costa
court.serves_note: Serves Antioch, Bay Point, Bethel Island, Brentwood, Byron, Discovery Bay, Knightsen, Oakley and Pittsburg (East County)
court.snippet: It is the courthouse for the former Delta Judicial District – the East County -- and serves the communities of Antioch, Bay Point, Bethel Island, Brentwood, Byron, Discovery Bay, Knightsen, Oakley and Pittsburg.
